paragraphs.text:
With  a  spring,  the  bird-monster  leaps  between  you  and 
Norman. You duck its cruel beak and the two of you flee in 
opposite directions. Your only chance is if the creature decides 
to chase Norman.
Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 356; if the result it odd, go to 368.
